name: the Python SDK defaults, a 10-turn loop, two minutes to answer
why: The banner is the assertion: over the wait the reader set, so it is one bad field with the setting as its note. Hand-derived: silent is 3 x 600 s + 0.5 + 1 s of backoff = 1,801.5 s a call, x 10 = 5.0 h; trickling is 4,096 tokens / 2 per s = 2,048 s, not retried because it returns 200, x 10 = 20,480 s = 5.7 h; overloaded is the two backoffs, 1.5 s, x 10 = 15 s. To fit 120 s: (120 - 10 x 1.5) / (3 x 10) = 3.5 s per attempt, so 3 s.

name: the default trickle, step by step: one attempt, one call and one task for each failure
why: The comparison table. Trickling: one attempt is 4,096 tokens / 2 per s = 2,048 s = 34.1 min, the call is the same because a 200 is not retried, and 10 turns make 5.7 h. Silent: 600 s, 3 x 600 + 1.5 = 1,801.5 s = 30 min, 5 h. Overloaded: refused at once, 1.5 s of backoff, 15 s. Only the two over 2 min are toned.
